profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Innovating with code
profile.summary:
Innovative and proven software engineer with 15+ years of experience analyzing, developing, and maintaining amazing scalable software applications.

Recently worked with AWS technology stacks that include Symfony, Laravel, Tailwind CSS, Livewire, and Lambda. I enjoy optimizing Software As A Service (SAAS) applications and am passionate about coding and learning new technologies.  Where would you like to take your business? Let's chat.

Specialties: 
• Software Development and Maintenance
• Solving Challenging Full Stack software development issues
• Bringing Clarity to Complex Issues 
• Managing a small agile team
• Content Management Systems (Interwoven TeamSite, Joomla, WordPress, etc.)
• Ability to translate business requirements into code
• Experience in Business and Data Modeling
• Experience in Business Process Re-engineering (BPR)

Technologies:
• Amazon Web Services (AWS)
• PHP
• RabbitMQ
• Symfony
• Laravel
• CakePHP
• JQuery
• Bootstrap
• Javascript, XHTML, HTML, CSS
• MySQL
• Opencart (E-commerce)

"Along with his undeniable talent, Robert has always been an absolute joy to work with. He is a true team player, and always manages to provide insightful feedback with an eye toward a positive customer experience." - Gavin Fysh, CEO and Founder Razor Planet, Inc.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
As a Senior Backend Software Engineer on the Mobile Originations Team, I work with an agile team of engineers to develop the APIs used in the mortgage origination process. Currently, I am migrating features from a previous vendor to the new platform.

Technology Stack:
- Laravel 5/8/10
- Horizon
- Redis
- MariaDB
- Apigee
- AWS
positions.insights: Skills: Git · PHP · Troubleshooting · Scrum · Laravel · Redis · Web-based Software Development · API · Communication · MariaDB · Apigee

positions.title: Owner
positions.description: Skills: Git · jQuery · Web-based Software Development · Communication · LAMP

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Los Angeles, California, United States · Remote
positions.description: Hired as a Lead Backend Software Engineer, I worked on a small agile team to provide the engine that runs our Digital Asset Management system used by some of the top film companies. My background in Full Stack development provided the perfect backdrop to excel with the API team. Our team uses RabbitMQ and concurrency programming to handle heavy and complex tasks. I managed LiveRooms, a secure, real-time collaborative product for media production workflow mainly used by leading theme parks.
positions.insights: Skills: Git · PHP · Troubleshooting · Kubernetes · RabbitMQ · MySQL · Redis · Symfony Framework · Web-based Software Development · Communication · Doctrine (PHP)

positions.title: Engineering Lead, Cyfe by Traject
positions.description:
The Engineering Lead at Cyfe (by Traject), where I managed a small, high-performing, cross-functional agile team. Cyfe is an All-in-one Business Dashboard Service with over 90+ integrations.

2022:
- Completed Chargebee Payment Processor Transition Project
- Improved Custom Domain SSL Processing
- Completed Exports 2.0 Project
- Completed Google Security Assessment
- Increased Third Party API Processing by 5x

2021:
- Achieved 80+ rating on AWS Well Architected Framework assessment
- Upgraded codebase to php 7.x
- Upgraded Cyfe Application to Laravel 7.x
- Improved application performance with redis cache and  mysql read replicas
- Improved security by refactored legacy session logins
- Completed security assessments from Google, QuickBooks and Xero
- Implemented automated testing process
- Lead Cyfe 2.0 R&D discussions
- Intergrated scrumban into Cyfe
- Improved ci/cd process with feature flagging

2020:
- Played integral part in helping Cyfe to gain Google partner status
- Upgraded infrastructure to Laravel 6
- Lead engineering incubator meetings
- Worked with product to improved Cyfe application ui/ux 
- Started security contributor program at Cyfe
- Developed the engineering roadmap for Cyfe
- Upgraded Cyfe production databases
- Integrated Pendo into Cyfe
- Upgraded AWS Lambda let's encrypt service
- Completed baseline AWS Well Architected Framework assessment
- Created admin panel for customer success team
- Implemented 2fa at Cyfe
positions.insights: Skills: Git · Laravel · Web-based Software Development · Communication · LAMP

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
The Engineering Lead at Cyfe, where I managed a small, high-performing, cross-functional agile team. Cyfe is an All-in-one Business Dashboard Service with over 90+ integrations. Rebranded Cyfe by Traject.

Key Accomplishments:
- Upgraded ftp deploy to git with AWS CodeDeploy
- Analyzed AWS cloud infrastructure
- Right-sized AWS infrastructure and reduced cost by over 75%
- Analyzed codebase and provided strategy for refactoring bottlenecks
- Improved existing Kanban process with regular stand-ups and feedback meetings
- Drafted incident response plan
- Upgraded codebase from php 5.x to php 5.6
- Created pre-production and testing environment
positions.insights: Skills: Git · Troubleshooting · Laravel · Web-based Software Development · Communication · LAMP

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Hired to help relieve the growing backlog of software development requests, I quick became to the "go-to" developer for the company's flagship products. My role expanded as the company grew and I became the Lead Software Engineer.

    • BLOQS Project – Designed and developed a highly scalable and adaptable CakePHP (MVC) application that allows the company to create and maintain websites for small to medium sized businesses.

    • Razorplanet CMS (V5,V6) Project – Designed and developed a CakePHP (MVC) application created to allow non-profit organizations to manage their websites.

    • Worldvision AIDs Experience Event Management Project –  Improved an existing ASP.NET (C#) application that Worldvision uses to manage their popular AIDs Experience traveling event. The application is designed to manage registration for volunteers and participants. 

"I thoroughly enjoyed my time working with Robert, and came to know him as a truly valuable asset to absolutely any team." -- Gavin Fysh, CEO and Founder Razor Planet, Inc
positions.insights: Skills: Troubleshooting · jQuery · Laravel · C# · Web-based Software Development · Communication · CakePHP · LAMP

positions.title: Systems Analyst / Web Content Management Administrator
positions.description:
Communicated complex information to business customers. Coordinated the development of system design and specifications. Facilitated business and data modeling groups. Analyzed business needs for inclusion in requests for proposals, feasibility studies, recommendations for new functionality and decision packages related to application systems. Developed Interwoven TeamSite templates and workflows. Managed Interwoven TeamSite jobs and tasks.

    • DRS Web Migration Project – Migrated the department’s website into the Interwoven TeamSite content management system.  Designed and implemented the department’s TeamSite deployment workflow.

    • Business Model Review  – Facilitated meetings and documented the department’s business processes.

    • Data Model Review – Facilitated meetings and documented the department’s database systems.

company.name: Washington State Department of Retirement Systems

positions.title: Systems Administrator
positions.description:
As the systems administrator at the Literacy Source, I was hired to manage the organizations local area network (LAN). My responsibilities grew as the organization recognized my strong programming and analytical skills.  

    • Literacy Source LAN project – Designed and implement the organization’s local area network (LAN) which consisted of multiple servers and a dozen (12+) computers.

    • Literacy Source Exchange Email Server Project – Installed and configured the organization’s first email server.  

    • Library Database System Project – Designed and implemented the organization’s library database which catalog books and their status.
